reason: The fixed five-object LAB recovery drill needs one immutable A/D routing boundary and one authenticated current-CP adapter. Two server production files reuse canonical bootstrap, policy-outbox, deletion journal, original-genesis and session checks rather than introducing an issuer, escrow actor or parallel collection semantics. The nine internal exports comprise seven mapping declarations/helpers, the reused originalGenesis helper, and route registration. Twenty relative imports wire these boundaries into existing routes/emission. Ordinary origins and shared nil scans remain unchanged; the explicit isolated nil reader rejects missing mapping and foreign members. This is temporary run-specific LAB support, removable with the drill profile, not a generalized recovery framework.
